svg.title: EntraGuard — detailed logical architecture
svg.desc: Logical responsibilities and authority boundaries. Internal modules share one Media Service process; they are not independent agent containers. Source-verified EntraGuard flow. Official Microsoft architecture icons.

text.tspan: Logical responsibilities and authority boundaries. Internal modules share one Media Service process; they are not independent agent
AZURE CONTAINER APPS · MEDIA SERVICE PROCESS / SHARED POLICY CODE
Public handbook is a separate app.
Three UI modes share one image.
Live call registries are in memory.
Per-participant audio → AI Speech → attributed transcript → AnalystClient
Graph sources → question selection → answer checks / optional follow-ups
AI produces structured risk, confidence, stage and evidence; it does not grant.
Treasury: durable receipt / history / policy / grants / outbox
EAM: in-memory flow and result; direct verification telemetry
Local SignalR hub; sink writes; 15-second recovery/outbox worker
Teams / ACS browser or handset web
Key Vault: EAM remote RS256 signing
Log Analytics via DCE / DCR; Sentinel
Operator server-side reads: KQL; also Graph and Resource Graph (not shown as separate nodes)
Solid arrows: primary logical interactions. Dashed arrows: supporting calls / reads. Graph and Azure dependencies return data on the same request paths.
Five Container Apps / three images. One media replica. Voice observes by default. Key Vault signs EAM; Treasury grants require durable receipts.
Source/configuration review · 20 September 2026 · not a live deployment audit · official Microsoft assets; sources in the companion guide.
